fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-01-07 at approximately 07:00, it was reported that a green scooter bearing registration number TN-57-YY-1064 of the complainant was reported missing from Anbu Puram Apartment Complex in Palakkad. Lavanya Raj reported the matter orally at Palakkad Town PS; the contact number given was 9000000127. The complaint mentions Arun Babu, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000379, in connection with the events. A further person, Siva Selvam, a business acquaintance, using the number 9000000440, is stated to be associated with the incident. A witness, Tamilarasan Velan, reachable on 9000000281, was mentioned in the complaint. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00243, as the mobile number 9000000379 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly taken after the handle lock was forced.
fields.Keywords: scooter theft, vehicle, witness, scooter, photograph, suspect, mobile number, apartment complex
